question: Why did the error rate go up on 12 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: Upstream payments-api is experiencing degraded performance, causing service checkout errors.
why_chain: payments-api returns HTTP 503, indicating degraded performance (E5).
checkout service experiences errors due to upstream payments-api timeout (E6, E7, E8).
payments-api status page shows degraded performance (E9).

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate is due to a sudden increase in request volume.
ruled_out.reason: Request volume for service checkout stayed about the same (E3).

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate is due to a sudden increase in users or requests.
ruled_out.reason: The error rate increase is not due to changes in other services (E2).

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate is due to a sudden increase in latency.
ruled_out.reason: The p95 latency for service checkout rose (E4).

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase is due to a configuration change in the checkout service.
ruled_out.reason: It rests on a change that is too early, or in a different service/region, to explain a sudden change here.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service checkout rose from 0.46% to 3.72% (+717%), with a change point at 2026-03-12T15:15:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service checkout: 3 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.17).
At the same time, request volume for service checkout stayed about the same (849 per 5 min before, 955 per 5 min after, +12%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service checkout rose (220 ms before, 399 ms after, +81%).
Upstream payments-api returning HTTP 503 for checkout (checkout; 2 min after the change; record R014; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
checkout: ERROR upstream payments-api timeout after 3 retries (checkout, ap-south; 3 min after the change; record R015; fit: describes a symptom, not a change)
checkout: ERROR upstream payments-api timeout after 3 retries (checkout, us-east; 8 min after the change; record R016; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
checkout: ERROR upstream payments-api timeout after 3 retries (checkout, eu-west; 12 min after the change; record R017; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
payments-api status page: investigating degraded performance (checkout; 30 min after the change; record R018; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)

reasons: ✓ A change event (alerts) lines up in time (2 min after the change).
✓ 4 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Monitor payments-api for any future performance issues.
